name: Project Context page: read-only tree of the seeded repo's specs/docs/insights, with preview
description: From the seeded payments-api repo, open Project Context via the sidebar (repo-scoped route, id resolved through the active-repo context), confirm the five matching fixture documents are listed and the non-matching src/readme.md is not, confirm the footer count, open a document and see it rendered as markdown, and confirm the page is read-only (no Edit / Upload buttons). Read-only seeded data written to a _seed clone dir by the seed CLI — see server/src/db/seed-project-context.ts. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo. Covers AC-7, AC-8, AC-11 (AC-10 and AC-40 need a mutable clone and are covered by RTL and integration tests).

steps.label: land on the PR list for the default repo
open Project Context from the sidebar
src/readme.md is outside the globs and absent
footer shows the indexed file count
the markdown body renders in the preview
the page is read-only: no Edit or Upload buttons
